user_decisions.sequence_clock: One value per year; Fibonacci cycle 24 years and King Wen traversal 64 years. Fixed origin while zooming.
user_decisions.background: Autoplay and loop; remove all play/pause controls.
user_decisions.daily_view: Space-weather selector, including solar wind and solar flares, plus online sentiment or hostility comparator.

background.source: Inner Planes / ISS - The Blue Pearl
background.format: H.264 Main, yuv420p, 1280x720, 24 fps, MP4 faststart
background.playback: Native autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline; same-origin MP4; positive backdrop stacking; visibility/pageshow and ordinary-interaction retries. No playback buttons.
background.verification_limit: Chromium mobile emulation is not physical iPhone Safari. OS autoplay restrictions remain browser-controlled.

implemented.navigation: Touch pinch, horizontal pan, Ctrl/Command wheel, zoom buttons and reset; single-finger vertical scrolling retained. Native reporting intervals and source data remain unchanged.
implemented.patterns: Zen dropdown: None, Fibonacci sequence, King Wen sequence, Timewave Zero. Native sequence steps on a separate scale; dense patterns request zoom rather than cover the solar trace. Historical Timewave preset remains authentic.
space_weather: GOES 0.1–0.8 nm X-ray flux, one-minute cadence and logarithmic display
implemented.daily_data: Current NOAA replacement RTSW feeds; only active spacecraft selected. Preserve source records and flags, missing values and source timestamps. Do not apply an unmodelled L1-to-Earth time shift. Mask GOES electron-contamination flags.
implemented.social_status: Online sentiment and hostility/bullying are selectable comparison intents. Provider data remains unconnected; no fabricated social trace, crawler or classifier.
implemented.kernel: Version 1.1.0 registers five dynamic feeds and yearly Zen clock; current 24-hour data exports separately as spacetime-24h/v2.
